Name: Simply Shane - A Dialogue Expansion Mod
Author: mattymattloaf
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/29KqJs3.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center][center][size=3]﻿[/size][/center][center][size=3]I have returned with yet another mod for you. This time, it's a spicy one for Shane! I missed writing the spice, so after writing something as vanilla as a Harvey mod, I had to hop back into it. This dialogue expansion adds around 400 lines of premarriage, marriage, festival, and gift dialogue. The vanilla events have been gone through for little grammar fixes (well, most of them—I got a little lazy, ngl).[/size]

[size=3]Since I can't actually code the events, Shane still supposedly quits drinking in the events. That doesn't line up with the way I wrote him, as he continues to drink regardless of what happens in those events. Sorry for the mismatch—I'd change it if I could![/size]

[size=3]Fair warning that Shane's also kind of mean in this.

[/size]Also, the cigarette in the banner is because my friend (who did the art) and I headcanon him as a smoker lol.

ETA: Someone found an issue where Shane, after his sobering-up events, still hates beer as a gift despite the way I've written him to still drink. I'm not sure where or how to change this in the code. I apologize for any inconvenience that causes! [insert crying emoji here]


[color=#9fc5e8][size=2]If you're interested in potentially collaborating with me as a coder, feel free to send me a message![/size][/color][url=https://ko-fi.com/mattymattloaf]

[/url][size=2][color=#93c47d]The banner art was made by my friend, who you can commission[/color] [url=https://www.fiverr.com/dietpoison]here![/url]﻿[/size][/center]
